image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a printed restaurant menu. The menu features multiple columns with red and black text on a white background. It includes sections for 'Specialty Pizzas', 'Gourmet Pizzas', 'Salads', and 'Desserts'. Prices are listed next to items. There is a logo or header at the top right that appears to say 'Ciao' in a script font. The paper shows some texture and slight curvature, suggesting it is a physical object.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom left corner and scattered small print
artifact_observations.reasoning: While the main headers and prices are legible, some of the smaller descriptive text and the text in the bottom-left inset appear slightly blurred or nonsensical upon close inspection, typical of AI-generated text where character structure degrades at smaller scales.

The left edge of the menu seems to warp slightly into the background/shadow area, lacking a crisp physical boundary. The perspective lines of the text columns do not perfectly converge to a single vanishing point, suggesting minor geometric inconsistency.
The yellowish surface beneath the menu has a uniform, slightly plastic-like smoothness that lacks realistic micro-texture or grain, appearing somewhat digitally painted.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the image is correctly classified as a menu and not a similar document like a flyer or receipt.
Critical for evaluating the legibility and correctness of the text, which is the primary functional component of a menu. Will detect gibberish or OCR failures.
To assess general image quality, lighting consistency, and detect subtle texture anomalies or blending issues between the menu and the table.
To verify the physical plausibility of the menu lying on the table, checking for correct shadows and depth separation.

focus_areas: Text legibility and semantic correctness of menu items
Geometric consistency of text lines and columns
Boundary sharpness between menu and background
Realism of paper texture and lighting shadows
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'image_text_auditor' results. If the text is largely coherent but has minor glitches in small print, weigh this less heavily than total gibberish. Check if the 'geometric_depth_auditor' finds any floating elements or incorrect shadow casting. The 'fine_grained_classifier' should easily confirm this is a menu, so focus on the quality of generation rather than class identity.
